title: Pedal Bar Crawl Tour of Downtown Phoenix
includes: Pickup and drop-off from designated meeting points
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Minimum numbers apply. We require six passengers in order to comfortably pedal the party bike. There is a possibility of cancellation after confirmation if there are not enough passengers to meet requirements. In the event of this occurring, you will be offered an alternative or full refund. We will let you know if there are changes at least 24 hours in advance
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Book up to 14 seats on this two-hour pub crawl of Downtown Phoenix, where your certified party bike pilot will bring you and your merry band of companions to three of our partner bars, where you'll receive exclusive drink specials! And with BYO legal on our pedal pub, all eyes will be on you as you're raising your cans and solo cups while pedaling and partying at the best that Phoenix has to offer!
